first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A heavy, dark mechanical firearm continuously visible at the lower center of the frame, with a central body extending forward and curved tube- or belt-like components on both sides.

entities.name: Snow-Covered Rocky Battlefield
entities.identification: The ground surface composed of dark rock fragments, fractured rock platforms, depressions, and discontinuous patches of light-colored snow.

entities.name: Upper Smoke-Cloud Background
entities.identification: The smoke and sky background above the distant terrain, usually blue-gray, and appearing extensively orange-yellow or gray-brown when illuminated by explosions.

entities.name: Explosion and Smoke-Dust
entities.identification: A collection of white-yellow and orange flames, radial sparks, flying debris, and expanding columns of smoke that repeatedly appear near the ground surface.

entities.name: Robot B
entities.identification: The humanoid mechanical body revealed near the upper edge of the rock platform right of center at the end of the clip, with its torso visibly covered by intense red-white light.
